capabilities: Build a conceptual map of vault ideas from tags, links, folders, and note recency
Pull relevant vault context automatically during chat
Quote vault notes with clickable note links and highlight used graph nodes
Work with OpenAI-compatible endpoints including local models
Run the agent core as a standalone CLI outside Obsidian
extras: VaultSearch uses the on-device index and does not call an AI provider, but initialization does; privacy details are in external docs. Included indexing credits require signing in, or users can pass OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL, and OPENAI_MODEL via advanced settings.
intentEvidence: Enzyme builds its context graph in a fraction of the time and tokens that Claude Code would use
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat that understands the ideas and relationships in a vault, and generic AI agents explore vaults slowly and expensively.
